title: Integration testing and verification
description: Run tests, verify all functionality works, and ensure code formatting is correct.
instructions: Run the existing tests to ensure nothing is broken: vendor/bin/sail artisan test --compact --filter=SystemManagement. Run linting/formatting: vendor/bin/sail bin pint --dirty --format agent. Verify: canvas is full-width, inspector is hidden, right-click shows simplified menu, Edit opens modal with tabs, all form fields work, connections can be made/removed, nodes can be dragged/organized.
verification: All tests pass, formatting is clean, all user-facing functionality works correctly
